name: io.github.QoreNext/qorenext-crm-mcp
description: Company hierarchy analysis and address verification via MCP

environmentVariables.name: QORENEXT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your QornextMCP API key. Get one at https://qorenext-app.azurewebsites.net/signup

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify MCP server is operational and get version info. No authentication required.

tools.name: submit_address_verification
tools.description: Submit companies for address verification. Validate company addresses and verify organization legitimacy. Required fields: companyName, country, address.

tools.name: submit_hierarchy_creation
tools.description: Submit companies for organizational hierarchy creation. Identify parent-subsidiary relationships and organizational structure. Required fields: companyName, country.

tools.name: submit_duplicates
tools.description: Submit duplicate entities from JSON, CSV, or Excel files for detection and merging. Required fields: crmAccountId, crmAccountName, addressLine1, country.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Get status and results of a screening request. Returns PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETE or FAILED with detailed results.
